source.name: Tranquil Boots
source.description: Fast movement. Recharges 20 health for allies around per 2 seconds.

descriptions.en: Fast movement. Recharges 20 health for allies around per 2 seconds.
descriptions.ru:
Быстрое передвижение.
 Восстанавливает 20 здоровья союзникам раз в 2 секунды.
descriptions.zh-cn: 快速移动，携带者使范围内的友军每2秒获得20点治疗。
descriptions.zh-tw: 快速移動，攜帶者使範圍內的友軍每2秒獲得20點治療。

notes: Immune to attack and ability when jumping
